facts.fact: Nile Post reports Finance Minister Henry Musasizi saying a Central Register of Non-Individuals, a digital repository to verify companies, is intended and that URSB has digitised its services; he asked URSB, URA, the Uganda Investment Authority and local governments to build interoperable systems and a one-stop centre.

UGA.note: Local governments are named only as agencies asked to link systems; no office connection is stated.
A stakeholder engagement on business registration reforms is not a named digital law or policy.
